title: Lab - CoreDNS
description: Resolve names and fix a broken resolver.
scenario: Resolve names and fix a broken resolver. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Find it
tasks.instructions: Which Pods run CoreDNS, which Service fronts them, and where is the Corefile?
tasks.solution:
kubectl get pods,svc -n kube-system -l k8s-app=kube-dns
kubectl get cm coredns -n kube-system -o yaml

tasks.title: Task 2 - Resolve
tasks.instructions: From the test Pod, resolve web-service in namespace payroll, using the shortest name that works.

tasks.title: Task 3 - Repair
tasks.instructions: An app cannot reach its database by name. Fix the Service name in its config.
tasks.solution:
kubectl exec <pod> -- nslookup mysql  # fails; the service is in another namespace
# use mysql.payroll
